verdict.rationale: The README shows models being pulled and run straight from Hugging Face repo IDs with the `-hf` flag, both for interactive use (`llama cli -hf ggml-org/Qwen3.5-0.8B-GGUF`) and for serving (`llama serve -hf ...`). That delivers the core of the story in a single step. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the download behavior (caching, quant selection, gated or private repos), evidence covering open models beyond GGUF-format repos, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the `-hf` workflow.
